:::{#exm-not-polar-question}
#### A question with four answers is not polar
<!-- no-figure: the example lists four sets, with nothing to plot -->

Let $X$ be as in @exm-question.
The question "What is the remainder of $X$ divided by $4$?" has four possible answers,
one for each remainder $r \in \{0, 1, 2, 3\}$:
the set of values $x \in \srcalph$ whose remainder is $r$.
These four sets form a [question](#def-question),
but not a [polar question](#def-polar-question), which has exactly two possible answers.

:::
